tutorial.welcome.en: Welcome, young leader. I am Sensei Hoshi. Our clan has found a hidden valley in the mountains. Let's build a village no rival can find.
tutorial.welcome.text: Karibu, kiongozi kijana. Mimi ni Sensei Hoshi. Ukoo wetu umepata bonde lililofichwa milimani. Tujenge kijiji ambacho hakuna mpinzani atakayekipata.

tutorial.mint.collect.en: Your Coin Mint is striking Coins. When a coin floats over it, tap it, then Collect.
tutorial.mint.collect.text: Kiwanda chako cha Sarafu kinatengeneza Sarafu. Sarafu ikielea juu yake, igonge, kisha Kusanya.

tutorial.mint.build.en: A clan runs on Coins. Tap Build and place a Coin Mint.
tutorial.mint.build.text: Ukoo unaendeshwa kwa Sarafu. Gonga Jenga na uweke Kiwanda cha Sarafu.

tutorial.keep.en: Now strengthen the Clan Keep: tap the castle, then Upgrade.
tutorial.keep.text: Sasa imarisha Ngome ya Ukoo: gonga kasri, kisha Boresha.

tutorial.finishKeep.wait.en: Upgrades take time. The Keep is ready in {time}: come back then, or tap Finish now to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishKeep.wait.text: Maboresho huchukua muda. Ngome itakuwa tayari baada ya {time}: rudi wakati huo, au gonga Maliza sasa kutumia Jade kidogo.

tutorial.finishKeep.done.en: The Keep is ready. Well done!

tutorial.army.tower.en: Rival clans will raid us. Build a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build, then the Defense tab): it shoots any raider in range.
tutorial.army.tower.text: Koo pinzani zitatuvamia. Jenga Mnara wa Kunai karibu na Ngome (Jenga, kisha kichupo cha Ulinzi): unampiga risasi mvamizi yeyote aliye karibu.

tutorial.army.all.en: Build a Training Dojo, a Squad Courtyard and a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build: the Army tab, then the Defense tab).
tutorial.army.all.text: Jenga Dojo ya Mafunzo, Uwanja wa Kikosi na Mnara wa Kunai karibu na Ngome (Jenga: kichupo cha Jeshi, kisha kichupo cha Ulinzi).

tutorial.train.en: Open the Army panel and train some Shinobi: fast blades that strike the nearest building.
tutorial.train.text: Fungua paneli ya Jeshi na ufunze Shinobi kadhaa: wapiganaji wepesi wa upanga wanaoshambulia jengo lililo karibu zaidi.

tutorial.finishTrain.wait.en: Training takes time too: your warriors are ready in {time}. Wait, or tap Finish training to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishTrain.wait.text: Mafunzo nayo huchukua muda: wapiganaji wako watakuwa tayari baada ya {time}. Subiri, au gonga Maliza mafunzo kutumia Jade kidogo.

tutorial.raid.en: Your first raid. Tap Attack, look over the target, then Attack! On the battlefield I will show you one thing at a time: send your Shinobi in through a glowing point, then smoke them as they reach a tower: warriors inside the smoke can only be shot from close up.
tutorial.raid.text: Uvamizi wako wa kwanza. Gonga Shambulia, kagua lengo, kisha Shambulia! Uwanjani nitakuonyesha jambo moja kwa wakati: tuma Shinobi wako kupitia kituo kinachong'aa, kisha uwafunike kwa moshi wanapofika kwenye mnara: wapiganaji walio ndani ya moshi wanaweza kupigwa tu kutoka karibu.

tutorial.end.en: Well fought. Raids fill your storage fast: upgrade the Clan Keep (or a storage) next. Then upgrade the Training Dojo to unlock Saboteurs: they jam a defense for a few seconds. Jam first, then strike, and smoke your warriors where the fire is heaviest. Collect, upgrade, raid, and join an Alliance.
tutorial.end.text: Umepigana vizuri. Uvamizi hujaza maghala yako haraka: sasa boresha Ngome ya Ukoo (au ghala). Kisha boresha Dojo ya Mafunzo ili kufungua Wahujumu: wanakwamisha ulinzi kwa sekunde chache. Kwamisha kwanza, kisha shambulia, na ufunike wapiganaji wako kwa moshi pale moto ulipo mkali zaidi. Kusanya, boresha, vamia, na ujiunge na Muungano.

whatsNew.0_1_0.en: What's new: send your squad in with one order, watch the fight up close or faster, and see what another entry point would have done. Every raid on your village now has a report, and you can test your defenses. New: a four-week event calendar with festivals, a weekly Gauntlet, daily contracts, achievements, Keep seals and looks to earn.
whatsNew.0_1_0.text: Kuna nini kipya: tuma kikosi chako kwa amri moja, tazama pambano kwa karibu au kwa kasi zaidi, na uone kituo kingine cha kupenya kingeleta nini. Kila uvamizi kwenye kijiji chako sasa una ripoti, na unaweza kujaribu ulinzi wako. Mapya: kalenda ya matukio ya wiki nne yenye matamasha, Changamoto Kuu ya kila wiki, mikataba ya kila siku, mafanikio, mihuri ya Ngome na mionekano ya kujishindia.

codex.rivalsRule.en: Computer rival clans read your last {n, plural, one {# raid} other {# raids}}: about {pct} of their outposts are tempered against the warriors you used most.
codex.rivalsRule.text: Koo pinzani za kompyuta husoma {n, plural, one {uvamizi wako wa mwisho} other {mavamizi yako # ya mwisho}}: karibu {pct} ya vituo vyao vya nje vimefuliwa dhidi ya wapiganaji uliowatumia zaidi.

codex.exhaustionRule.en: For {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} after each raid your village loses, the next raider can take only {pct} as much (two losses multiply).
codex.exhaustionRule.text: Kwa {hours, plural, one {saa #} other {saa #}} baada ya kila uvamizi ambao kijiji chako kinashindwa, mvamizi anayefuata anaweza kuchukua {pct} tu ya kiasi cha kawaida (kushindwa mara mbili huzidishana).

codex.temperRule.en: From Clan Keep {level}, defenses can be tempered: Reach shoots farther but softer, Blast hits groups but fires slower, Watch strengthens air defense and traps. Each rival clan leans one way:
codex.temperRule.text: Kuanzia Ngome ya Ukoo ngazi {level}, majengo ya ulinzi yanaweza kufuliwa: Masafa hupiga mbali zaidi lakini kwa nguvu kidogo, Mlipuko hupiga makundi lakini hufyatua polepole zaidi, Ulinzi huimarisha kinga ya angani na mitego. Kila ukoo pinzani huegemea upande mmoja:

codex.counters.text: {building} hufanya kazi dhidi ya {list} (kwa kupimwa vitani).

builders.crewNote.en: The garrison crew builds defenses, traps and support counters without taking a Village Artisan.
builders.crewNote.text: Kikosi cha ngome hujenga majengo ya ulinzi, mitego na majengo ya msaada bila kumtumia Fundi wa Kijiji.

squad.armed.en: Tap a glowing ring: the rest of your warriors go in through it.
squad.armed.text: Gusa pete inayong'aa: wapiganaji wako waliobaki wataingia kupitia hiyo.

calendar.about.en: One reward a day, the same for everyone, never random and never sold. Miss a day and nothing is lost: the next claim is the next day on the list. Day 28 gives a Keep look.
calendar.about.text: Zawadi moja kwa siku, ile ile kwa kila mtu, kamwe si ya bahati nasibu na kamwe haiuzwi. Ukikosa siku hakuna kinachopotea: dai linalofuata ni siku inayofuata kwenye orodha. Siku ya 28 inatoa mwonekano wa Ngome.

calendar.next.text: Siku inayofuata ya kalenda baada ya {time}.

calendar.gotLook.en: A new Keep look is yours: Store → Looks.
calendar.gotLook.text: Mwonekano mpya wa Ngome ni wako: Duka → Mwonekano.

offers.noAge.text: Ofa maalum huonekana tu baada ya kutuambia umri wako (Mipangilio → Akaunti → Matumizi → Weka kundi la umri).

offers.minor.en: Special offers do not pop up for players under 18. Everything in the Jade tab stays available within your spending limit.
offers.minor.text: Ofa maalum hazijitokezi kwa wachezaji walio chini ya miaka 18. Kila kitu kwenye kichupo cha Jade kinapatikana ndani ya kikomo chako cha matumizi.

store.withdrawalStipend.en: Delivery starts at once: the first payment can be claimed now and one more each day; by buying you agree that you lose the right to cancel, as the law allows for digital content.
store.withdrawalStipend.text: Uwasilishaji unaanza mara moja: malipo ya kwanza yanaweza kudaiwa sasa na mengine moja kila siku; kwa kununua unakubali kwamba unapoteza haki ya kughairi, kama sheria inavyoruhusu kwa maudhui ya kidijitali.

net.clockOff.en: This device's clock is off by about {minutes} min. Online timers and war phases follow the server: set the clock to automatic in the device settings.
net.clockOff.text: Saa ya kifaa hiki imekosea kwa takriban dakika {minutes}. Vipima muda mtandaoni na awamu za vita hufuata seva: weka saa iwe otomatiki kwenye mipangilio ya kifaa.

raid.reportPending.en: Your last raid is still being sent to the server. Try again in a moment; Practice and Trials still work.
raid.reportPending.text: Uvamizi wako wa mwisho bado unatumwa kwenye seva. Jaribu tena baada ya muda mfupi; Mazoezi na Majaribio bado yanapatikana.

save.restoredPrevious.en: Your latest save could not be read, so an earlier copy ({when}) was loaded.
save.restoredPrevious.text: Hifadhi yako ya karibuni haikuweza kusomwa, kwa hiyo nakala ya awali ({when}) imepakiwa.

frame.failed.title.en: Something went wrong drawing the village
frame.failed.title.text: Hitilafu imetokea wakati wa kuchora kijiji

frame.failed.body.en: Your village is saved. Reload to keep playing.
frame.failed.body.text: Kijiji chako kimehifadhiwa. Pakia upya ili uendelee kucheza.

save.openFailed.body.en: This device didn't open its saved village in time. Try again, or play a temporary village for now: it is not saved and stays offline.
save.openFailed.body.text: Kifaa hiki hakikufungua kijiji chako kilichohifadhiwa kwa wakati. Jaribu tena, au cheza kijiji cha muda kwa sasa: hakihifadhiwi na kinabaki nje ya mtandao.

store.error.unavailable.en: Purchases are not available right now. Try again later.
store.error.unavailable.text: Ununuzi haupatikani kwa sasa. Jaribu tena baadaye.

store.error.failed.en: The purchase did not go through. If you were charged, it is delivered as soon as the store confirms it.
store.error.failed.text: Ununuzi haukufanikiwa. Ikiwa ulitozwa, utawasilishwa mara tu duka litakapothibitisha.

raid.rejected.expiredAt.en: Its report (from the raid on {date}) reached the server after the 72-hour limit.
raid.rejected.expiredAt.text: Ripoti yake (ya uvamizi wa {date}) ilifika kwenye seva baada ya kikomo cha saa 72.

raid.rejected.defender_protected.text: Kijiji hicho kilikuwa tayari na ngao.

raid.rejected.no_warriors.en: No warriors fought, so it counts as practice.
raid.rejected.no_warriors.text: Hakuna mpiganaji aliyepigana, kwa hiyo inahesabiwa kama mazoezi.

temper.intro.en: Shape every {building} at once. Reach shoots farther but hits softer and goes for back-line warriors first; Blast hits groups but fires slower; Watch makes the Sky Bow Tower, the Bitter Smoke Brazier and traps stronger. Raiders see the shape when they scout.
temper.intro.text: Unda upya kila jengo la aina hii kwa mara moja: {building}. Masafa hupiga mbali zaidi lakini kwa nguvu ndogo na hulenga kwanza wapiganaji wa nyuma; Mlipuko hupiga makundi lakini hufyatua polepole; Ulinzi huimarisha Mnara wa Upinde wa Angani, Kichomeo cha Moshi Mchungu na mitego. Wavamizi huona umbo hilo wanapopeleleza.

temper.locked.text: Ufuaji unafunguka kwenye Ngome ya Ukoo {level}.

temper.left.en: {n, plural, one {# point left} other {# points left}}

temper.done.en: Tempered: every {building} has its new shape.
temper.done.text: Umefua: kila jengo la aina {building} lina umbo jipya.

temper.watchSupport.en: Watch also weakens the raiders' healing, revives, toughness and shield cover across the whole base.
temper.watchSupport.text: Ulinzi pia hudhoofisha uponyaji, ufufuaji, ustahimilivu na kinga ya ngao za wavamizi katika kambi nzima.

stake.help.en: Declare a result before you attack: reach it and carry more loot home, miss it and carry none.
stake.help.text: Tangaza matokeo kabla ya kushambulia: ukiyafikia unabeba nyara zaidi nyumbani, ukiyakosa hubebi chochote.

stake.missed.en: Stake missed: you declared {stars}★, so no loot came home.
stake.missed.text: Dau limekosekana: ulitangaza {stars}★, kwa hiyo hakuna nyara zilizofika nyumbani.

carry.diversity.en: Your squad carried {pct} of the loot. Squads of more roles carry more.
carry.diversity.text: Kikosi chako kilibeba {pct} ya nyara. Vikosi vyenye kazi nyingi tofauti hubeba zaidi.

carry.preview.en: This army would carry {pct} of the loot. Squads of more roles carry more.
carry.preview.text: Jeshi hili lingebeba {pct} ya nyara. Vikosi vyenye kazi nyingi tofauti hubeba zaidi.

raid.rejected.conflict.en: The opponent changed at the same moment.

raid.rejected.version_mismatch.en: This version of the game is too old.
raid.rejected.version_mismatch.text: Toleo hili la mchezo ni la zamani mno.

ledger.refundReversed.text: Urejeshaji wa pesa umebatilishwa, ununuzi umerudishwa

res.debt.en: You owe {amount} {resource} from a refunded purchase. It is paid back from your future income; nothing else is taken.
res.debt.text: Unadaiwa {amount} {resource} kutokana na ununuzi uliorejeshewa pesa. Kinalipwa kutoka kwenye mapato yako yajayo; hakuna kingine kinachochukuliwa.

The village on the server is the one kept.} other {The server refused # actions because your village had changed, for example on another device. The village on the server is the one kept.}}

Kijiji kilicho kwenye seva ndicho kinachobaki.} other {Seva ilikataa vitendo # kwa sababu kijiji chako kilikuwa kimebadilika, kwa mfano kwenye kifaa kingine. Kijiji kilicho kwenye seva ndicho kinachobaki.}}

news.offline.en: Messages from the game's operators arrive when you play online.
news.offline.text: Jumbe kutoka kwa waendeshaji wa mchezo hufika unapocheza mtandaoni.

account.signOutDevice.note.en: Finished playing on this phone or browser? Sign it out. Your online account stays for your other devices and linked sign-ins.
account.signOutDevice.note.text: Umemaliza kucheza kwenye simu au kivinjari hiki? Toka humo. Akaunti yako ya mtandaoni inabaki kwa vifaa vyako vingine na njia za kuingia zilizounganishwa.

account.signOutDevice.body.en: Online play turns off here and this device forgets its key to your online account. The village on this device stays. To play the account here again, sign in with a linked Apple, Google or Game Center account.
account.signOutDevice.body.text: Kucheza mtandaoni kunazimwa hapa na kifaa hiki kinasahau ufunguo wake wa akaunti yako ya mtandaoni. Kijiji kilicho kwenye kifaa hiki kinabaki. Ili kucheza akaunti hii hapa tena, ingia kwa akaunti ya Apple, Google au Game Center iliyounganishwa.

account.signOutDevice.done.en: This device is signed out. Online play is off here.
account.signOutDevice.done.text: Umetoka kwenye kifaa hiki. Kucheza mtandaoni kumezimwa hapa.

account.signOutDevice.pending.en: Not signed out yet: some of your play is still being sent (actions: {actions}, battle reports: {raids}). Try again when the connection is better.
account.signOutDevice.pending.text: Bado hujatoka: sehemu ya mchezo wako bado inatumwa (vitendo: {actions}, ripoti za vita: {raids}). Jaribu tena muunganisho ukiwa bora.

account.signOutDevice.lastKey.en: Not signed out: this device holds the only key to your online account. Link Apple, Google or Game Center first, or delete the account instead.
account.signOutDevice.lastKey.text: Hujatoka: kifaa hiki kina ufunguo pekee wa akaunti yako ya mtandaoni. Unganisha Apple, Google au Game Center kwanza, au badala yake ufute akaunti.

news.reason.resources.en: There were not enough resources in your village on the server.
news.reason.resources.text: Hapakuwa na rasilimali za kutosha katika kijiji chako kwenye seva.

news.reason.builder.text: Hakuna Fundi wa Kijiji aliyekuwa huru.

news.reason.maxLevel.en: It was already at its highest level.
news.reason.maxLevel.text: Tayari ilikuwa katika ngazi yake ya juu kabisa.

news.reason.gone.en: It was no longer in your village.

news.reason.busy.en: It was already being worked on.

news.reason.limit.en: The limit for it was already reached.

news.reason.army.text: Viwanja vyako vya Kikosi vilikuwa vimejaa.

news.reason.changed.en: Your village had already changed, for example on another device.
news.reason.changed.text: Kijiji chako kilikuwa kimeshabadilika, kwa mfano kwenye kifaa kingine.

refusal.storageFullRefund.en: Storage is too full: cancelling now would lose {lost} of the {refund} you would get back. Make room first.
refusal.storageFullRefund.text: Maghala yamejaa mno: ukighairi sasa utapoteza {lost} kati ya {refund} ambazo ungerudishiwa. Tengeneza nafasi kwanza.

league.boardOnline.en: The leaderboards are part of online play.
league.boardOnline.text: Ubao wa viongozi ni sehemu ya kucheza mtandaoni.

sheet.raidRule.en: Raiders can take {pct} of what your storages hold, never more than {cap} of each resource while your Keep is level {level}, and {collectors} of what your collectors have not collected yet.
sheet.raidRule.text: Wavamizi wanaweza kuchukua {pct} ya kilichomo kwenye maghala yako, kisichozidi {cap} kwa kila rasilimali wakati Ngome yako iko ngazi {level}, na {collectors} ya kile ambacho bado hakijakusanywa kutoka kwenye vikusanyaji vyako.

sheet.collectorPause.en: It produces nothing while it upgrades ({time}). What it holds now stays and can still be collected.
sheet.collectorPause.text: Haizalishi chochote inapoboreshwa ({time}). Kilichomo sasa kinabaki na bado kinaweza kukusanywa.

unlock.title.en: {n, plural, one {New warrior unlocked!} other {New warriors unlocked!}}
unlock.title.text: {n, plural, one {Mpiganaji mpya amefunguliwa!} other {Wapiganaji wapya wamefunguliwa!}}

keep.armyBehind.en: Your warriors' training is more than a Keep behind your village: a higher Keep meets stronger rivals and raiders. Research or train first?
keep.armyBehind.text: Mafunzo ya wapiganaji wako yako nyuma ya kijiji chako kwa zaidi ya ngazi moja ya Ngome: Ngome ya juu zaidi hukutana na wapinzani na wavamizi wenye nguvu zaidi. Utafiti au mafunzo kwanza?

scout.lootWontFit.en: Your storage cannot hold all the loot on offer: what does not fit is lost.
scout.lootWontFit.text: Maghala yako hayawezi kubeba nyara zote zinazopatikana hapa: nyara zinazozidi hupotea.

trials.caughtUp.en: Tiers {from} to {to} are counted as cleared too, each paid once.
trials.caughtUp.text: Madaraja {from} hadi {to} pia yanahesabiwa kuwa yamekamilika, kila moja likilipwa mara moja.

drill.title.text: Zoezi la kila siku (mazoezi: hakuna kinachotumika)

drill.about.en: Daily drill: fight this fortress with a full camp of your own warriors. Nothing is spent, and today's first drill pays a small reward.
drill.about.text: Zoezi la kila siku: pigana na boma hili ukiwa na kambi kamili ya wapiganaji wako mwenyewe. Hakuna kinachotumika, na zoezi la kwanza la leo hulipa zawadi ndogo.

drill.paid.en: Drill done: today's reward is paid. Nothing was spent.
drill.paid.text: Zoezi limekamilika: zawadi ya leo imelipwa. Hakuna kilichotumika.

drill.doneToday.en: Today's drill reward is already paid. You can still drill for practice; the next reward comes tomorrow.
drill.doneToday.text: Zawadi ya zoezi la leo tayari imelipwa. Bado unaweza kufanya zoezi ili kujizoeza; zawadi inayofuata itakuja kesho.

scout.shieldEnds.en: Your shield has {time} left: attacking ends it.
scout.shieldEnds.text: Muda uliobaki wa ngao yako: {time}. Kushambulia kunaimaliza.

tutorial.end.daily.en: Your first daily chest is ready: Finish opens it.
tutorial.end.daily.text: Kasha lako la kwanza la kila siku liko tayari: Maliza inalifungua.

panel.loadFailed.en: This could not open. Check your connection and try again.
panel.loadFailed.text: Hiki hakikuweza kufunguka. Kagua muunganisho wako kisha ujaribu tena.

panel.staleChunk.en: A newer version of Kagemura is out. Reload to open this.
panel.staleChunk.text: Toleo jipya zaidi la Kagemura limetoka. Pakia upya ili kufungua hiki.

quality.slowBattles.en: This phone drew battles slowly, so Kagemura will use lighter graphics from the next start. You can change it in Settings → Graphics.
quality.slowBattles.text: Simu hii ilichora vita polepole, kwa hiyo Kagemura itatumia michoro myepesi zaidi kuanzia utakapofungua tena. Unaweza kubadilisha hili kwenye Mipangilio → Michoro.

events.calendar.server.en: Schedule sent by the game's server. Every countdown is real.
events.calendar.server.text: Ratiba iliyotumwa na seva ya mchezo. Kila hesabu ya muda ni ya kweli.

events.calendar.builtIn.en: Built-in schedule. Every countdown is real.
events.calendar.builtIn.text: Ratiba iliyojengwa ndani. Kila hesabu ya muda ni ya kweli.

events.fixed.en: Events follow a fixed calendar: a four-week cycle plus five festivals on fixed dates each year. Their times never move or get extended, so the countdown is always the real one.
events.fixed.text: Matukio hufuata kalenda isiyobadilika: mzunguko wa wiki nne pamoja na matamasha matano kwenye tarehe zisizobadilika kila mwaka. Nyakati zake hazisogezwi wala kurefushwa, kwa hiyo muda unaohesabiwa ni wa kweli kila wakati.

contract.about.en: The same for everyone today; a new one in {time}. It changes only what a won raid carries home.
contract.about.text: Ni ule ule kwa kila mtu leo; mpya baada ya {time}. Hubadilisha tu kile ambacho uvamizi wa ushindi huleta nyumbani.

events.gauntlet.generated.text: Ngome ya Changamoto Kuu (iliyotengenezwa na kompyuta).

events.gauntlet.about.en: A computer-made fortress, the same base for everyone at your Keep this week. No loot inside; each star mark on the ladder pays once.
events.gauntlet.about.text: Ngome iliyotengenezwa na kompyuta, kambi ile ile kwa kila mtu katika Ngome yako wiki hii. Hakuna nyara ndani; kila alama ya nyota kwenye ngazi hulipa mara moja.

events.festival.about.en: A computer-made fortress at your Keep, the same for every attempt. No loot inside; each mark on the ladder pays once, and three stars give the festival's look.
events.festival.about.text: Ngome iliyotengenezwa na kompyuta katika Ngome yako, ile ile kila jaribio. Hakuna nyara ndani; kila alama kwenye ngazi hulipa mara moja, na nyota tatu huleta mwonekano wa tamasha.

growth.invite.rule.en: When a friend who started with your friend code reaches Keep {keep} with their village on the server, you each get a fixed reward. Nothing random and nothing to buy.
growth.invite.rule.text: Rafiki aliyeanza kwa msimbo wako wa rafiki akifikia Ngome {keep} akiwa na kijiji chake kwenye seva, kila mmoja wenu anapata zawadi isiyobadilika. Hakuna cha nasibu wala cha kununua.

growth.invite.reward.en: Reward for each of you: {jade} Jade
growth.invite.reward.text: Zawadi kwa kila mmoja wenu: Jade {jade}

growth.invite.cap.en: {cap, plural, one {Rewards for up to # friend a month.} other {Rewards for up to # friends a month.}}
growth.invite.cap.text: {cap, plural, one {Zawadi kwa hadi rafiki # kwa mwezi.} other {Zawadi kwa hadi marafiki # kwa mwezi.}}

growth.invite.counts.en: Friends who joined with your code: waiting {waiting}, ready {ready}, rewarded {rewarded}
growth.invite.counts.text: Marafiki waliojiunga kwa msimbo wako: wanasubiri {waiting}, tayari {ready}, wamezawadiwa {rewarded}

growth.invite.mine.waiting.en: You joined with a friend's code. Reach Keep {keep} with your village on the server and you both get the reward.
growth.invite.mine.waiting.text: Ulijiunga kwa msimbo wa rafiki. Fikia Ngome {keep} ukiwa na kijiji chako kwenye seva na nyote wawili mtapata zawadi.

growth.invite.mine.ready.en: You joined with a friend's code and reached Keep {keep}: your reward is ready.
growth.invite.mine.ready.text: Ulijiunga kwa msimbo wa rafiki na umefikia Ngome {keep}: zawadi yako iko tayari.

growth.invite.mine.rewarded.en: You joined with a friend's code and collected your reward.
growth.invite.mine.rewarded.text: Ulijiunga kwa msimbo wa rafiki na umekusanya zawadi yako.

growth.invite.needsServer.en: Rewards go to a village on the server. Move your village there in Settings → Online play.
growth.invite.needsServer.text: Zawadi huenda kwa kijiji kilicho kwenye seva. Hamishia kijiji chako huko kwenye Mipangilio → Kucheza mtandaoni.

growth.invite.adultsOnly.en: Friend invite rewards are for adults only. You can still add friends and play together.
growth.invite.adultsOnly.text: Zawadi za kualika marafiki ni za watu wazima pekee. Bado unaweza kuongeza marafiki na kucheza pamoja.

growth.invite.enterHint.en: {days, plural, one {Enter their friend code within # day of starting online play.} other {Enter their friend code within # days of starting online play.}}
growth.invite.enterHint.text: {days, plural, one {Weka msimbo wa rafiki yako ndani ya siku # tangu uanze kucheza mtandaoni.} other {Weka msimbo wa rafiki yako ndani ya siku # tangu uanze kucheza mtandaoni.}}

growth.share.explain.en: {days, plural, one {The server checks this replay and keeps it for # day under a code. Anyone with the link can watch it. The base is shown without its name and your opponent is never named.} other {The server checks this replay and keeps it for # days under a code. Anyone with the link can watch it. The base is shown without its name and your opponent is never named.}}
growth.share.explain.text: {days, plural, one {Seva hukagua marudio haya na kuyahifadhi kwa siku # chini ya msimbo. Yeyote mwenye kiungo anaweza kuyatazama. Kambi inaonyeshwa bila jina lake na mpinzani wako hatajwi kamwe.} other {Seva hukagua marudio haya na kuyahifadhi kwa siku # chini ya msimbo. Yeyote mwenye kiungo anaweza kuyatazama. Kambi inaonyeshwa bila jina lake na mpinzani wako hatajwi kamwe.}}

growth.share.minor.en: Your name is not shown on replays shared by players under 18.
growth.share.minor.text: Jina lako halionyeshwi kwenye marudio yanayoshirikiwa na wachezaji walio chini ya miaka 18.

growth.viewer.player.text: Dhidi ya kambi ya mchezaji halisi.

growth.viewer.generated.en: Against a generated base (made by the computer).
growth.viewer.generated.text: Dhidi ya kambi iliyotengenezwa na kompyuta.

growth.viewer.failed.en: This shared replay could not be opened.

growth.viewer.older.en: This replay was recorded under other battle rules, so this version of the game cannot show it.
growth.viewer.older.text: Marudio haya yalirekodiwa chini ya sheria nyingine za vita, kwa hiyo toleo hili la mchezo haliwezi kuyaonyesha.

alliance.banner.next.text: Bendera inayofuata katika ngazi {level} ya Muungano.

alliance.banner.note.en: Banners only change how the Alliance looks: no advantage in battle or resources.
alliance.banner.note.text: Bendera hubadilisha tu mwonekano wa Muungano: hakuna faida katika vita wala rasilimali.

stats.tzNote.en: It also sends your time zone's offset from UTC, so days are counted on your own calendar.
stats.tzNote.text: Pia hutuma tofauti ya saa za eneo lako na UTC, ili siku zihesabiwe kwa kalenda yako mwenyewe.

preview.notLive.en: Preview: this is not in the live game yet.
preview.notLive.text: Onyesho la awali: hiki bado hakimo kwenye mchezo halisi.

heroPick.intro.en: Choose the hero who joins your attacks.
heroPick.intro.text: Chagua shujaa atakayejiunga na mashambulio yako.

heroPick.none.en: No hero can join yet. Heroes join from higher Keep levels.
heroPick.none.text: Bado hakuna shujaa anayeweza kujiunga. Mashujaa hujiunga kuanzia ngazi za juu zaidi za Ngome.

mastery.none.en: Attack with your warriors to earn mastery.
mastery.none.text: Shambulia ukitumia wapiganaji wako ili kupata ustadi.

seal.progress.en: Keep seal: {total, plural, one {{n} of # building} other {{n} of # buildings}} at this Keep's cap. A full Keep earns its seal.
seal.progress.text: Muhuri wa Ngome: {total, plural, one {jengo {n} kati ya # limefikia} other {majengo {n} kati ya # yamefikia}} kikomo cha Ngome hii. Ngome iliyokamilika hupata muhuri wake.

terms.body.en: The terms of service for Kagemura came into force on {date}. Please read them and accept them to play online. Your village keeps working on this device either way.
terms.body.text: Masharti ya huduma ya Kagemura yalianza kutumika tarehe {date}. Tafadhali yasome na uyakubali ili kucheza mtandaoni. Kijiji chako kinaendelea kufanya kazi kwenye kifaa hiki kwa vyovyote vile.

consent.apple.label.en: Help Apple decide refund requests (off until you turn it on)
consent.apple.label.text: Saidia Apple kuamua maombi ya kurejeshewa pesa (imezimwa hadi uiwashe)

consent.apple.detail.en: When you ask Apple for a refund, Apple may ask us about the purchase. With this on, we tell Apple that it was delivered and give ranges for how old your account is and how much you have bought and been refunded. Never your name, village or chat. We never ask Apple to refuse a refund.
consent.apple.detail.text: Unapoiomba Apple ikurejeshee pesa, Apple inaweza kutuuliza kuhusu ununuzi huo. Hili likiwa limewashwa, tunaiambia Apple kwamba ununuzi uliwasilishwa na tunatoa makadirio ya umri wa akaunti yako na kiasi ulichonunua na kurejeshewa. Kamwe si jina lako, kijiji chako wala gumzo. Kamwe hatuiombi Apple ikatae kurejesha pesa.

replays.allowBase.label.en: Allow my base in other players' shared replays
replays.allowBase.label.text: Ruhusu kambi yangu kwenye marudio yanayoshirikiwa na wachezaji wengine

replays.allowBase.detail.en: When someone shares a replay of a raid on your village, it shows your base layout (never your name). Turn this off and your base is never shown, and shares already made of it are removed.
replays.allowBase.detail.text: Mtu anaposhiriki marudio ya uvamizi dhidi ya kijiji chako, yanaonyesha mpangilio wa kambi yako (kamwe si jina lako). Zima hili na kambi yako haitaonyeshwa kamwe, na marudio yaliyokwisha kushirikiwa yanayoionyesha yataondolewa.

significantUpdate.description.en: This update changes how Kagemura works. A parent or guardian can review it before it is used.
significantUpdate.description.text: Sasisho hili linabadilisha jinsi Kagemura inavyofanya kazi. Mzazi au mlezi anaweza kulikagua kabla halijatumika.

season.recap.en: League at season end: {league}. Raids won: {raids}. Stars: {stars}. Scroll tiers: {tiers}.
season.recap.text: Ligi mwishoni mwa msimu: {league}. Mavamizi uliyoshinda: {raids}. Nyota: {stars}. Madaraja ya Gombo: {tiers}.

welcome.scrollEnded.en: The Season Scroll ended, and the rewards you had not claimed were added:
welcome.scrollEnded.text: Gombo la Msimu limeisha, na zawadi ambazo hukuwa umedai zimeongezwa:

pass.bonus.detail.en: {left, plural, =0 {All {max} bonuses collected this season ({got} of {max})} one {Every task still pays: the next bonus in # point ({got} of {max} this season)} other {Every task still pays: the next bonus in # points ({got} of {max} this season)}}
pass.bonus.detail.text: {left, plural, =0 {Ziada zote {max} zimekusanywa msimu huu ({got} kati ya {max})} one {Kila kazi bado inalipa: ziada inayofuata baada ya pointi # ({got} kati ya {max} msimu huu)} other {Kila kazi bado inalipa: ziada inayofuata baada ya pointi # ({got} kati ya {max} msimu huu)}}

settings.reduceEffects.text: Punguza mtikisiko wa skrini na mimweko

stake.recentHits.en: {raids, plural, one {Your last raid:} other {Your last # raids:}} 2★ or more in {two}, 3★ in {three}.
stake.recentHits.text: {raids, plural, one {Shambulizi lako la mwisho:} other {Mashambulizi yako # ya mwisho:}} 2★ au zaidi katika {two}, 3★ katika {three}.

whatsNew.0_2_0.en: What's new: choose a larger text size, and turn screen shake and flashes down, in Settings. The stake picker shows how often your recent raids reached two and three stars. Shadow Trials climb more evenly, and raids at Keep 4 and Keep 15 meet fairer opponents.
whatsNew.0_2_0.text: Kipya: chagua maandishi makubwa zaidi, na upunguze mtikisiko wa skrini na mimweko kwenye Mipangilio. Kichaguzi cha dau kinaonyesha mara ngapi mashambulizi yako ya karibuni yalifikia nyota mbili na tatu. Majaribio ya Kivuli yanapanda kwa usawa zaidi, na mashambulizi kwenye Ngome 4 na 15 yanakutana na wapinzani wa haki zaidi.
